en.highlight: The work simulates Caenorhabditis elegans at small scale on Loihi-2 using NeuroML2Loihi to address the computational cost of neural simulation.
en.summary: The paper reports a small-scale neural simulation of Caenorhabditis elegans on Loihi-2 using NeuroML2Loihi. It frames neural simulation as essential for studying biological nervous systems but constrained by the computational cost of repeatedly updating neural and synaptic states. The work is a hardware-oriented attempt to address that constraint.
en.failureAnalysis: The supplied source contains only the title and an abstract fragment, with no results on simulation scale, accuracy, energy use, or baseline comparisons, so its practical advantage over conventional simulation cannot be assessed.

articles.title: Leonxlnx/earshot
articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: GitHub + Community signal
articles.summary: 该 GitHub 仓库名为 Earshot，已获得 2131 星并有近期公开活动；其描述是为编程智能体提供“耳朵”，让 AI 听见、审查并发出声音，且仅用 CPU、开源。它的可读价值在于呈现了一个把音频感知与反馈接入 AI 编程工具的开源方向，CPU-only 也降低了试用和部署门槛。
articles.failureAnalysis: 仅凭公开描述，“听见、审查并发出声音”对编程智能体的真实需求仍不明确，音频反馈可能不如文本日志直接，用户是否愿用、愿付费缺少验证。CPU-only 虽降低部署门槛，也可能在音频质量、延迟和复杂场景处理上受限。开源加 2131 星能带来关注，但若不能证明对开发效率的可量化提升，项目容易停留在演示层，工程集成和持续维护也会成为负担。

en.highlight: Ears for coding agents: let AI hear, review and make sound. CPU-only, open source.
en.summary: This GitHub repository, Earshot, has 2,131 stars and recent public activity. Its description says it provides ears for coding agents so AI can hear, review, and make sound, while being CPU-only and open source; it is worth reading as an open direction for adding audio perception and feedback to AI coding tools.
en.failureAnalysis: The real demand for hearing, reviewing, and making sound in coding agents is still unclear, and audio feedback may add noise rather than measurable coding value. CPU-only and open source lower deployment barriers, but may also constrain audio quality, latency, and sustained engineering.
